restated: An adversary with existing access to Windows hosts on this network harvested credentials from those hosts.
what_would_confirm: Evidence of credential dumping or theft on Windows hosts, such as LSASS memory access by non-standard processes, use of known dumping tools (e.g., Mimikatz, ProcDump, comsvcs.dll MiniDump), SAM/NTDS.dit or registry hive extraction, DPAPI secret access, or anomalous authentication with stolen credentials.
